lcc_original: 以挪士在世的日子、共有九百零五年，然後死。
notes: UNV {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} are implicit (no surface word); LCC has explicit 有 ('had/were') → promoted to explicit attachment per rule 3: 有<WAH01961><WTH8799>
UNV {<WH03117>} (יְמֵי, days) is implicit; LCC has explicit 日子 → promoted to explicit attachment: 日子<WH03117>
共<WAH03605> preserved: 共 in LCC maps to כָּל (H3605, 'all/altogether'), same as UNV
在世的 is an LCC explanatory gloss on 日子 ('in the world') with no Hebrew equivalent → left unannotated
然後 is an LCC transitional phrase (cf. UNV 就, also unannotated) → left unannotated
Two distinct H8141 tokens in Hebrew (שָׁנָה after hundreds + שָׁנִים after five) both attach to the single 年 in LCC per rule 6; LCC collapses 九百零五年 into one unit rather than 九百...年零五歲 structure
